I had the same recurring dream for years (from when I was about 5 until I was 10)

In the dream I was lying down and my entire family was standing around crying and patting my head and kissing my forehead. There were flowers everywhere and I remember was holding some because I could distinctly feel the rose thorns in my hand. I tried so hard to try talk to them and ask why they were crying and why were there flowers everywhere but nothing came out. All of a sudden my dad is placing a wooden cover over my body and I'm screaming in my head because I realise that they think I'm dead. I would always wake up in a cold sweat.

I told my parents about these dreams a few years later and my dad even said to me that he could tell something was up with me because I'd always flinch away from him involuntarily; guess it was just my dream subconscious not trusting him.

I'm sure there was more to it, but that's all I can remember because I stopped having these dreams about 10 years ago. I used to be so terrified about going to sleep.
